Welcome to Kinna's Kitchen
Taste of South East Asia Laos, Made in New Mexico USA
About Kinna's Kitchen
Kinna's Kitchen Chile Products was founded in 2013 with a simple but flavorful mission: to share the bold, authentic taste of traditional Laos cuisine through handcrafted chile products.
Our journey began in the heart of our family kitchen, where Grandma lovingly created her signature Laos Chile Paste—a vibrant, savory blend of spices that added the perfect kick to many traditional Laos dishes. What started as a staple at family gatherings quickly became a favorite among friends, neighbors, and eventually, a wider community of food lovers who craved something truly original.
Inspired by Grandma’s passion and recipes passed down through generations, we decided to turn her beloved chile paste into the foundation of a business. With that, Kinna's Kitchen was born.
Since launching with our first product, the Laos Chile Paste, we’ve continued to grow—still guided by our family roots and commitment to quality. Every jar we make carries the bold flavors and cultural richness of Laos, crafted with care and tradition in every batch.
At Kinna’s Kitchen, we believe food is more than just nourishment—it’s a connection to heritage, to family, and to the joy of sharing something truly special.
Welcome to our kitchen. We're glad you're here.
Learn More
Kinna's Kitchen
Kinna’s Kitchen Chile Products are proudly crafted using all-natural ingredients and produced in small batches to ensure exceptional quality and flavor. We never use artificial preservatives, stabilizers, or additives—just honest, wholesome ingredients you can trust.
You can find our products at Whole Foods Market locations in Albuquerque and Santa Fe, NM, as well as at local co-ops, Ta-Lin International Market, and Keller’s Farm Stores. Our full product line is also available online at
kinnas.net
and
kinnaskitchen.com
.
To experience the bold, authentic flavors of Laos, visit one of our retail partners or order directly from our website.

The Full Story
About
Mission
At Kinna’s Kitchen, we bring more than just chile products—we bring authentic taste, tradition, and quality you can trust. Each jar is crafted with care, using all-natural ingredients and small-batch methods to deliver bold, vibrant flavors inspired by genuine Laos recipes.
We provide you with versatile, handcrafted sauces and pastes that transform everyday meals into memorable culinary experiences. Whether you’re cooking family dinners, hosting friends, or exploring new flavors, our products add depth, spice, and cultural richness to your table.
With Kinna’s Kitchen, you’re not just enjoying great food—you’re connecting to a heritage of flavor, family, and love.
Vision
At Kinna’s Kitchen, our vision is to bring the authentic, vibrant flavors of traditional Laos cuisine to kitchens everywhere—celebrating heritage, quality, and community through every jar. We strive to honor our family roots by crafting chile products that are natural, wholesome, and bursting with bold flavor.
We envision a future where our products inspire home cooks and food lovers alike to explore new tastes, share cultural stories, and connect over the joy of good food. As we grow, we remain committed to sustainability, supporting local producers, and maintaining the small-batch craftsmanship that defines us.
Ultimately, we aim to be more than just a brand—we want to be a bridge that connects people to the rich culinary traditions of Laos and the warmth of family, one flavorful bite at a time.

Recipes
Explore the bold, vibrant flavors of our handcrafted chile products with these easy, delicious recipes made to bring the taste of Laos to your kitchen.
🌶️ Laos Chile Paste
Spicy Stir-Fried Noodles
Ingredients:
2 tbsp Laos Chile Paste
8 oz rice noodles (cooked)
1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
Fresh cilantro (optional)
Instructions:
In a hot skillet, add sesame oil and stir-fry vegetables until tender.
Add Laos Chile Paste and soy sauce; stir well.
Toss in cooked noodles and mix until evenly coated.
Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.
🌿 Vegan Chile Paste
Vegan Spicy Tofu Bowl
Ingredients:
2 tbsp Vegan Chile Paste
1 block extra-firm tofu (cubed)
1 tbsp olive oil
1 cup cooked jasmine rice
1 cup steamed greens (bok choy, spinach, or kale)
1 tsp lime juice
Instructions:
Pan-fry tofu in olive oil until golden.
Add Vegan Chile Paste and cook for 2–3 minutes to coat.
Serve tofu over rice with steamed greens.
Drizzle with lime juice before serving.
🥭 Vegan Mango Salsa
Mango Salsa Tacos
Ingredients:
1/2 cup Vegan Mango Salsa
1 can black beans (drained)
1 avocado (sliced)
Corn tortillas
Shredded cabbage or lettuce
Instructions:
Warm tortillas and layer with black beans, avocado, and cabbage.
Top with a generous spoonful of Vegan Mango Salsa.
Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!
🍋 Vegan Tamarind Chile Sauce
Tamarind Glazed Chick’n Skewers
Ingredients:
1/4 cup Vegan Tamarind Chile Sauce
1 package vegan chicken strips or chunks
Bell peppers & red onions (cubed)
Skewers (wooden or metal)
Instructions:
Assemble skewers with vegan chicken and vegetables.
Brush with Vegan Tamarind Chile Sauce.
Grill or bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes, brushing again halfway.
Serve with rice or salad and extra sauce for dipping.
